name: pixel-haxe
description: Pixel Api — Hafif ve cok hedefli Haxe API mikro-framework'u. A lightweight, multi-target Haxe API micro-framework. Router, route groups, middleware, CORS, JSON, cookies, Bearer auth, rate limiting, security headers, ETag caching, validation, scheduled tasks, OpenAPI docs, live metrics panel and static file serving; runs on Node.js, PHP, Neko and HashLink.
releasenote: v0.5.0: guvenlik basliklari (Helmet benzeri), ETag/If-None-Match onbellek (304), kural tabanli istek dogrulama (422) ve zamanlanmis arka plan gorevleri. Helmet-like security headers, ETag/If-None-Match caching (304), rule-based request validation (422) and scheduled background tasks.
